source: Money Rooms v3 Level 8 spec: the discovery call; MR-073 rewrote the script (hourly or salary, any number of roommates and partners, labelled fields, the fit questions)

questions.name: What should I call you?
questions.birth: When were you born, or how old are you?
questions.dependents: Does anyone depend on your income, kids or family?
questions.work: How would you describe work right now?
questions.employerType: What kind of place do you work for?
questions.roommates: Do you live with roommates? How many?
questions.lease: Whose name is on the lease?
questions.partners: Is there a partner, or partners, whose money is part of this picture?
questions.whyNow: What made you reach out now?
questions.tried: What have you tried so far, apps, budgets, advice from anyone?
questions.ifNothing: If nothing changes over the next year, what does that look like?
questions.payType: Are you paid hourly, or on a salary?
questions.salary: What is your salary before tax?
questions.hoursPerWeek: About how many hours a week do you work?
questions.variesGross: In a typical month, what comes in before tax?
questions.payFrequency: How often do you get paid?
questions.takeHome: What lands in your account each time you are paid, after taxes and deductions?
questions.takeHomeMonth: What lands in your account in a typical month?
questions.steadiness: How steady is that, month to month?
questions.contrib: Do you put anything into a 401k or similar, and does your employer match it?
questions.cash: Any cash or savings accounts? Rough balances are fine.
questions.bigComing: Anything big coming in the next year or two, a move, a wedding, a car?
questions.gutTotal: If you had to guess, what goes out in a normal month?
questions.goals: If we were talking a year from now and things had gone well, what would be different?
questions.stuck: Where do you feel most stuck?
questions.struggle: What is the biggest struggle with money right now?
questions.avoids: Do you tend to avoid looking at your accounts?
questions.stress: On a scale of one to ten, how stressed do you feel about money right now?
questions.workStyle: How do you like to work: a quick weekly check-in, or a longer sit-down less often?
questions.decisionMakers: Who else weighs in on money decisions?
questions.worthIt: Three months from now, what would make this worth it for you?
questions.partnerPayType: Are they paid hourly, or on a salary?
questions.partnerTakeHome: And what lands in their account each time they are paid?

gentleWords.reveal: We will look at how the real numbers compare once you have gathered them yourself.
gentleWords.guess: These are averages for your area, not your numbers. Want to swap any for yours?
gentleWords.homework: Before next time, a photo of each statement is plenty. No logins needed on the call.

intros.snapshot: Rapport first. Nothing here is a test.
intros.why: The reason they called is the reason they will stay. Get it in their words.
intros.money: Rough numbers are fine. Anything they do not know goes on their plate, not yours.
intros.spending: Only what they volunteer. Anything left blank gets an average for their cost area.
intros.goals: What would be different a year from now, and by when.
intros.mindset: How they feel about money decides how the sessions run.
intros.fit: Cadence, who else is involved, and what would make this worth it.
intros.words: Verbatim, one line each. Saved as said.

city.label: City
city.unit: city, state if you know it

bigComing.label: Coming up
bigComing.example: moving in June, maybe a car
